purpose: Teach: 役に立ち/即時/役場/強固/着信/インセンティブ/力量/上京

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、君の研究、産業界に、役に立ちうるか、視点を、持て。
lines.en: Ren — think about whether your research could have practical value in industry.
lines.style: Measured, unhurried authority. Light pause before key phrase. Not a question, a directive framed as thoughtful guidance. Leans back slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験結果、即時、ノートに、記録するようにしています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm making sure to record experimental results in my notebook immediately.
lines.style: Quiet respect. Slight hurry in the delivery—eager to show he's competent. Clear enunciation on 'immediately.' Eyes steady but not quite relaxed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 役場の協力、地域研究、進める上で、欠かせないぞ。
lines.en: The local office's cooperation is essential for moving the regional research forward.
lines.style: Firm, factual tone. Slight emphasis on 'essential'—not negotiable. Measured pace. Weight of experience in every clause.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室、データ管理、強固な体制で、運営しております。
lines.en: Yes. We're running the lab's data management with a solid system in place.
lines.style: Slightly defensive—wants to prove readiness. Pace quickens on 'solid system.' Professional tone masking underlying anxiety about evaluation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文査読、依頼の着信、即、確認するようにしろ、見落とすな。
lines.en: When review requests come in, verify them immediately. Don't miss anything.
lines.style: Direct, no softening. Short sentences with clean endings. Slight pressure behind the words—this matters. Eyes make contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究、論文掲載のインセンティブ、若手、活発化しています。
lines.en: Yes. Research incentives for publication are motivating the younger members.
lines.style: Rapid delivery—overcorrecting with eagerness. Slightly breathless, as if he's rushing to show progress. Small nervous pause before finishing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究者として、君の力量、評価しているぞ、これからも、頑張れ。
lines.en: I'm evaluating your ability as a researcher. Keep working hard.
lines.style: Warmth enters for the first time. Slower pace. The words land heavier because they're sparse. Small nod implied. Genuine respect underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地方の大学から、上京して、学んできて、本当に、よかったと思います。
lines.en: Yes. Coming up to Tokyo from a local university and learning all this—I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Emotional restraint breaking. Quiet voice. Slight catch as if the gratitude surprised him saying it out loud. Trailing softly at the end, sincere.
